header.title: Claim Adjustment Reason Codes (index)
header.method: WebFetch of the public page; model-extracted CODE|START|LAST_MODIFIED|STOP index read in two offsets; 13 rows re-fetched and compared (all matched)

coverage.note: The fetch tool reads at most ~115-140k characters of page text; rows after P7 (P-series continues, plus W- and Y-series codes) were not reachable in this session. Codes beyond that point are absent, not deleted.

license.statement: X12 states on the source page: "All X12 work products are copyrighted." and use must comply with X12 Intellectual Property policies.
license.policy: Only code identifiers, published dates, and short description excerpts needed for routing are stored. Full descriptions and usage notes require a licensed X12 code-list import before production use (build pack doc 04).
